english.note: Use this formal abstract noun when discussing how pressing a matter is, rather than the everyday adjective 急.

examples.english: The urgency of this matter is obvious, so we need to hurry.
examples.traditional: 呢件事嘅迫切性好明顯，我哋要快啲處理。
